name: @coralogix/staghorn
//version: Frozen on purpose. The release workflow resolves the next version from the latest v* git tag and stamps it into the package ephemerally in CI, so nothing is ever committed to the default branch and the tag is the sole record of what shipped.
description: Every git branch gets its own localhost hostname instead of a port, via one shared unprivileged reverse proxy. Zero dependencies, no sudo, no /etc/hosts, no config.
author: Coralogix Ltd.
//exports: Two notes, since comment keys are illegal INSIDE exports (they must start with './'). (1) ESM declarations are .d.ts, not .d.mts: tsup emits .d.ts for the ESM pass and .d.cts for the CJS pass, and since the package is type:module a .d.ts is read as ESM declarations, pairing with index.mjs. (2) './proxy' is a FILE LOCATOR, not an importable API - resolve-proxy-entry.ts calls require.resolve on it to find the daemon to spawn, and it is deliberately a bare string because a conditions object makes require.resolve throw ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED for CJS consumers. Both verified by publint + attw in CI.
//overrides: Dev-only transitives with published advisories. Scoped to their parents on purpose: a blanket vite override would drag vitest 5 back from vite 8 to 6. Nothing here ships - the package has zero runtime dependencies and files is dist/README/LICENSE/NOTICE - so these only affect the test run and the docs build.
//publishConfig: A scoped package is restricted by default, so access must be stated. Provenance is generated automatically under npm trusted publishing, and is declared here so a manual publish cannot silently omit it.

scripts.//check:pkg: profile node16 because node10 predates `exports`, so subpath resolution is inherently unavailable there (the main entry still works via types/main and IS checked). ./proxy is excluded because it is a file locator for the daemon spawn, not an importable API - it has no types on purpose.
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check:pkg && npm run check:scrub && npm run license:check
